tools.name: freeq_channels
tools.description: List the public channels on this server with member counts and topics. Start here when you do not know a channel's exact name. Invite-only, key-protected and encrypted-only channels are never listed. No authentication required.

tools.name: freeq_history
tools.description: Read recent messages from a channel, newest first. Page backwards by passing the oldest msgid you have seen as `before`. Public channels need no authentication; restricted ones need a bearer from a member.

tools.name: freeq_search
tools.description: Full-text search within one channel. Use this instead of paging history when you know roughly what was said. Same access rules as freeq_history.

tools.name: freeq_verify
tools.description: Check who signed a message. `signed_by: "author"` is non-repudiable — the author's own key signed those bytes. `signed_by: "server"` proves relay only, NOT authorship. Call this before quoting anyone as having said something; do not present a server-relayed message as author-signed.

tools.name: freeq_pins
tools.description: The messages a channel's operators pinned — usually its rules, links and standing context. Cheaper than reading history when you want to know what a channel is for.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "freeq_history" references sensitive artifacts (bearer). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
